extracted.name: Prawn & aubergine curry
extracted.description: Enjoy this vibrant prawn and aubergine curry with flatbreads for a quick and easy midweek meal for two. It’s ideal on busy nights when you’re short on time
ingredient_lines: 400g can cherry tomatoes or chopped tomatoes
½ small bunch of coriander chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium-high heat, and fry the aubergine with a pinch of salt for 5 mins until lightly golden. Stir in the chilli, ginger, turmeric and cumin, cook for another minute, then pour in the cherry tomatoes. Simmer for 10 mins until thickened.
Stir in the prawns and simmer for 2-4 mins until pink. Remove from the heat, stir in the coconut yogurt, lime juice and coriander, then serve with the warmed rotis.
